summary.text: Patrick Burke is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly representing District 142, which he has represented since January 1, 2019, and is seeking re-election on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served on the Erie County Legislature from 2013 to 2018.
